name: Papercut
tagline: papercut-explainer: layered construction paper, a taped banner in Archivo Black, torn Fraunces tags per word, paper boil.

motion.direction: papercut-explainer. Cream construction paper with torn edges and masking tape; the banner (taped strip at y 14–21 %, 3–7 caps words in Archivo Black) states the takeaway and never repeats the voice; captions are one coral `ter` tag per word in Fraunces, pages of 1–3 words, each word popping 0.6 → 1.05 → 1 in 3–5 frames, random rotation ±5°. Props pop in on a 6–9 frame spring (scale 0 → 1.08 → 1, ±4°), then BOIL (held poses, ±1–2 px jumps). Hard cut on banner change, 9–17 cuts per 30 s; one visual event per stressed word. Orthographic, no gradients, no outlines; saturation only on captions, signals and the hero.
